tokens.name: obsidian-canvas
tokens.usage: Factory raw. Page canvas of the dark theme. Read it through `background`.

tokens.name: carbon-lift
tokens.usage: Factory raw. One step above the canvas: nav well, panels, metric dividers.

tokens.name: ash-stroke
tokens.usage: Factory raw. Hairline borders and ghost-link outlines on the dark canvas.

tokens.name: graphite-mid
tokens.usage: Factory raw. Neutral chart bodies and inactive bars. Never text on the dark canvas (2.1:1).

tokens.name: warm-granite
tokens.usage: Factory raw. Muted body copy on the dark canvas (5.1:1 on obsidian, 4.65:1 on carbon).

tokens.name: pale-stone
tokens.usage: Factory raw. Mono eyebrows, column heads, tertiary copy on the dark canvas (9.2:1).

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Factory raw. Primary text on dark, the light figure card, the light theme canvas.

tokens.name: chalk
tokens.usage: Factory raw. Light button fill, selection ring on dark, light theme panels.

tokens.name: signal-orange
tokens.usage: Factory raw. Live status and data signal on dark (5.7:1). Never a chrome fill. On bone use `signal`.

tokens.name: metric-green
tokens.usage: Factory raw. Positive metric on dark (10.3:1). On bone use `positive`.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The page ground of every screen and every report section.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised chrome: side rail, detail panel, popover, header well. One level only.

tokens.name: surface-secondary
tokens.usage: Fill of the dark filled button and of a hovered or selected rail row.

tokens.name: figure
tokens.usage: The figure card: the one bright object on the ground (report callout, key figure). Inverts in the light theme.

tokens.name: on-figure
tokens.usage: Text and marks on `figure` (16.4:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text, names and values on `background` and `surface` (16.4:1 and 14.9:1).

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Report prose, secondary values, sources. On `background` and `surface` (dark 5.1 and 4.65, light 7.7).

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Mono uppercase labels: eyebrows, column heads, attribute keys, legend titles (dark 9.2, light 5.4 on bone, 4.75 on surface-secondary).

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairline between rows and metric tiles. Decoration only.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Outline of a panel, a card, a ghost link. Decoration only.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Edge of a control a person must find: field, toggle, checkbox (3.3:1 dark, 3.2:1 light).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the one button that commits the step. Neutral, never chromatic.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `primary` (18.2:1).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring (2px solid, 2px offset) and the selection ring on the graph and the map. 18:1 on the ground.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Live and unverified: candidate data, live pulse, active report step, highlighted series. Dark 5.7, light 4.6 on bone.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Positive change, added fact, promoted evidence count. Dark 10.3, light 4.9 on bone.

tokens.name: candidate
tokens.usage: Machine layer, not promoted. Always with the word CANDIDATE and a hollow glyph.

tokens.name: added
tokens.usage: An addition on the review surface. Always with a + mark.

tokens.name: dissent
tokens.usage: Disagreement between agents, destructive action. Lighter than `signal` on dark (8.6 vs 5.7), so the two never rely on hue. Always with a ! mark.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Text and edge of a destructive control. Never a fill.

tokens.name: entity-vessel
tokens.usage: Vessel. Glyph: triangle. Graph node, map marker, rail row, legend. Dark 8.9, light 5.2.

tokens.name: entity-port
tokens.usage: Port. Glyph: notched square. Dark 9.2, light 4.6.

tokens.name: entity-facility
tokens.usage: Facility: refinery, terminal, plant. Glyph: square. Dark 9.4, light 4.5.

tokens.name: entity-company
tokens.usage: Company. Glyph: circle. Dark 9.2, light 4.9.

tokens.name: entity-bank
tokens.usage: Bank, central bank included. Glyph: portico. Dark 8.8, light 5.2.

tokens.name: entity-person
tokens.usage: Person. Glyph: hexagon. Dark 8.4, light 5.6.

tokens.name: entity-state-body
tokens.usage: Ministry, agency, regulator, council. Glyph: pentagon. Dark 8.6, light 5.4.

tokens.name: entity-legal-act
tokens.usage: Legal act, sanctions regulation. Glyph: folded sheet. Dark 8.4, light 5.5.

tokens.name: entity-military-unit
tokens.usage: Military unit. Glyph: NATO hostile diamond. Dark 8.4, light 5.5. Lighter than `signal` on dark.

tokens.name: entity-event
tokens.usage: Event: a dated claim (strike, fire, stoppage). Glyph: four-point burst. Shares `signal` on purpose: a claim is live, not evidence.

tokens.name: entity-unknown
tokens.usage: Unknown type. Glyph: dashed circle. Grey is a state: no type recognised.

tokens.name: relation-ownership
tokens.usage: Owns, flags, insures, appoints, subordinate to. Solid line.

tokens.name: relation-designation
tokens.usage: Designated, restricted or exempted by a legal act. Long dash 12 5.

tokens.name: relation-operation
tokens.usage: Operates, charters, supplies, flows to, calls at. Short dash 5 4.

tokens.name: relation-transfer
tokens.usage: Ship-to-ship transfer. Dash-dot 12 4 2 4.

tokens.name: relation-other
tokens.usage: A type that no family holds. Dotted 2 5.

tokens.name: chart-neutral
tokens.usage: Context series and bars: all the reader is not asked to look at.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines and baselines in a chart. 1px.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Axis ticks and tick labels (mono 12px).

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Sea and lakes. Darker than land on dark, lighter than land on light.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Land fill of the basemap.

tokens.name: map-boundary
tokens.usage: Country borders and coastlines, 1px.

tokens.name: map-label
tokens.usage: Place names on the basemap (Geist 12px). 4.8:1 on land.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Report cover title only. One per page.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Report step title and metric value.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: GAB adaptation. Entity name at the top of the detail panel.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The vessel changed flag three times in 2024.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Interface text: panel rows, rail rows, buttons, links.

styles.name: body-sm-strong
styles.usage: Only where a label must dominate a dense surface. Never a heading.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Always UPPERCASE: eyebrows, column heads, status tags, legend titles, units.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: GAB adaptation. Identifiers, coordinates, dates, counts. Tabular figures, sentence case.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: Key identifier in a panel header.

tokens.name: spacing-4
tokens.usage: GAB adaptation. Glyph to label, tag padding.

tokens.name: spacing-8
tokens.usage: Base unit. Row padding, gap inside a control.

tokens.name: spacing-12
tokens.usage: GAB adaptation. Dense panel padding on working screens.

tokens.name: spacing-16
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between panel blocks.

tokens.name: spacing-24
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gap, element gap.

tokens.name: spacing-32
tokens.usage: Gap between report text blocks.

tokens.name: spacing-40
tokens.usage: Gap above a chart in the report.

tokens.name: spacing-56
tokens.usage: Gap between a step title and its figure.

tokens.name: spacing-80
tokens.usage: Report step to report step.

tokens.name: spacing-96
tokens.usage: Section gap. Chapter to chapter.

tokens.name: spacing-120
tokens.usage: Above and below the report cover.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Ghost link, table, the graph and map frames.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags, nav items, hover card.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, figure card, phone sheet.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: The largest panel only: the framed figure of the report.

tokens.name: page-max-width
tokens.usage: Report and public pages content width.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: GAB adaptation. Button, input, toggle.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: GAB adaptation. Rail row, attribute row, table row.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: GAB adaptation. App header (the Factory site uses 64px).

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Left filter rail on desktop.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Right detail panel on desktop.

tokens.name: glyph-size
tokens.usage: Entity glyph in a list, a legend or a panel.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Default for every surface. Depth is contrast, not blur.

tokens.name: shadow-hairline
tokens.usage: The only shadow: a 1px ring on a popover over a canvas.
